package.name: fv_browser_camera
package.description: Browser webcam bridge: serves a demo page over HTTP, receives JPEG frames from a visitor's browser (getUserMedia) over WebSocket, and publishes them as sensor_msgs/Image. Routes frames to one of several downstream detector topics (instant model switching) and streams the selected overlay back to the browser on the same WebSocket. Designed for single-port free-tier hosting (e.g. Hugging Face Spaces).
